authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/novation/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/novation/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the guide's MIDI parameter table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the guide prints no Device Inquiry reply.

18 CC pair(s) are the coarse controller alone, 0 - 127: each pair is a controller and its partner 32 above, MIDI's coarse and fine, and the Circuit Mono Station's guide says the second "is used to create an 8-bit message for a 0-255 value range" without saying which bit it carries. Oscillator 1 Coarse (CC 14, fine CC 46); Oscillator 1 Fine (CC 15, fine CC 47); Oscillator 1 LFO2 > Pitch (CC 16, fine CC 48); Oscillator 2 Coarse (CC 17, fine CC 49); Oscillator 2 Fine (CC 18, fine CC 50); Oscillator 2 LFO2>Pitch (CC 19, fine CC 51); Oscillator 3 Coarse (CC 20, fine CC 52); Oscillator 3 Fine (CC 21, fine CC 53); Oscillator 3 LFO2 > Pitch (CC 22, fine CC 54); Mixer Osc1 (CC 23, fine CC 55); Mixer Osc2 (CC 24, fine CC 56); Mixer Osc3 (CC 25, fine CC 57); Ring 1*2 (CC 26, fine CC 58); Noise Level (CC 27, fine CC 59); Filter Frequency (CC 29, fine CC 61); Filter LFO1 > Filter (CC 28, fine CC 60); LFO 1 Rate (CC 30, fine CC 62); LFO 2 Rate (CC 31, fine CC 63).
Left out, printed with the range 0-0 ( to+): Osc Common Noise HPF (NRPN 0:12).
Left out, not a control change or an NRPN (a program change, pitch bend, aftertouch, or none): Arp/Clock Rate (NA NA:NA).
Left out, a message another row already has: Spread (NRPN 0:5).
